technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: Average of other Mobitool datasets created with the purpose of replacing older datasets in the database. Basis for fleet shares: Switzerland year 2020. Source: HBEFA 5.1, INFRAS

review.common:reviewDetails: Data from HBEFA 5.1 for the year 2020. Some technologies with very small shares in the fleet removed for simplicity. Technology shares normalised to ensure sum of 100%

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
